criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Inquiries related to exchanging currencies, including fees and rates.

categories.name: Refund Requests
categories.definition: Requests for refunds on transactions or purchases.

categories.name: Card Issues
categories.definition: Problems or inquiries regarding card functionality, including activation and usage.

categories.name: Fraud and Security
categories.definition: Concerns about unauthorized transactions or potential fraud.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Requests related to account settings, including updates and deletions.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Inquiries about money transfers, including delays and declines.

categories.name: Top-Up Inquiries
categories.definition: Questions regarding adding funds to accounts or cards.

categories.name: ATM Issues
categories.definition: Problems encountered while using ATMs, including card retrieval and cash dispensing.

categories.name: Payment Processing
categories.definition: Questions about payment statuses, including pending and declined payments.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Inquiries related to the verification of identity for account access or transactions.

categories.name: Card Delivery
categories.definition: Questions regarding the status and delivery of physical cards.

categories.name: Contactless Payments
categories.definition: Issues or inquiries related to using contactless payment methods.

categories.name: Documentation Requirements
categories.definition: Questions about necessary documents for account setup or verification.

categories.name: Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries about various fees associated with services, transactions, or accounts.

categories.name: Disposable Cards
categories.definition: Questions regarding the use and management of disposable or virtual cards.

categories.name: Cash Deposits
categories.definition: Inquiries related to depositing cash into accounts.

categories.name: Account Security
categories.definition: Concerns regarding the security of accounts and measures to protect them.

categories.name: Service Availability
categories.definition: Questions about the availability of services in specific locations or for specific users.

categories.name: Transaction Disputes
categories.definition: Requests to dispute or investigate specific transactions.

categories.name: General Inquiries
categories.definition: Miscellaneous questions that do not fit into other categories.
